title: Playback Audio Language Default Policy
problem: Playback can honor explicit audio stream selection, but has no request-scoped language/default policy for multi-audio HLS audio groups.

evidence.summary: Opened a durable lane for request-scoped playback audio language/default selection after HLS audio sidecar output shape cleanup.
Added request-scoped preferred audio languages, deterministic playback audio selection precedence, and server HLS propagation of the selected transcode track.

Surfaced preferred audio languages through the public HLS query path, asserted HLS audio rendition default flags and explicit stream precedence, and updated OpenAPI plus generated TypeScript/Kotlin SDKs.

Verified and closed the request-scoped playback audio language/default policy lane, updating architecture/workstream docs and splitting persisted settings, subtitle policy, codec-aware audio, downmix/normalization, UI controls, LL-HLS, DASH, DRM, and offline sync as follow-ons.

continue_policy.notes: The request-scoped playback audio language/default policy first slice is complete. Open follow-on workstreams for persisted user settings, UI controls, subtitle language policy, codec-aware audio, downmix/normalization, LL-HLS, DASH, DRM, or offline sync.
